mapper.select: SELECT id, username, email, phone_e164, password_hash, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, username, email, phone_e164, password_hash, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT id, username, email, phone_e164, password_hash, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, email, phone_e164, password_hash, role, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{phoneE164}, #{passwordHash}, #{role}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.username, u.email, u.phone_e164, u.password_hash, u.role, u.status, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM users u JOIN user_project_alert_subscription s ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE u.status = 'active' AND s.project_id = #{projectId} AND ( CASE s.min_alert_level WHEN 'blue' THEN 1 WHEN 'orange' THEN 2 WHEN 'red' THEN 3 ELSE 99 END ) <= #{levelNum}
